function: Excluded (function): learned conv-1D speed predictor and MLP regress the water level and its variation speed from RSRP, i.e., sensing; the ISAC beams are fixed steering vectors (p. 2, p. 3).
notes: Passes checks 1-4: research letter; the DL models process received radio signals, so learning is at the physical layer. Excluded at check 5 (function): the learned method only estimates an environmental parameter. p. 3: "We propose a novel DL model to train the pre-processed signals with suppressing the interference paths and estimate the water level"; the speed predictor outputs "the water-level variation speed". The ISAC part that area 5 covers is not learned. p. 2: "For simplicity, we use steering vectors to determine fS and fC", with a fixed time-division sensing/communication schedule (Eq. (4)). All results are sensing RMSE. p. 5: "Fig. 6 presents the RMSE of the speed and height estimates versus epochs". The experiment senses only, p. 4: "The beam scanning function δS (t) equals 1 constantly." No communication metric is reported. For the reviewer: the system does communicate in separate slots, so the example "sensing alone in a system that does not communicate" does not apply literally. The exclusion rests on the learned method designing no beams, waveforms, or resources (area 5) and estimating no channel (area 2). Multi-antenna ULAs (p. 2, Nt = Nr = 16 p. 5), so check 6 would not apply.
